==Description==
'''Inflation''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Exploding Enemies]] and before [[Committed]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

==Effects==
When applied, the placement, upgrade and ability costs of towers are increased by 50%.

==Update History==
*'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]]
**'''Inflation''' added.
*'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]]
**Reward boost increased from +20% to +30%.
